author: jaeD
text_post: Is the Game actually detrimental? I write this amidst an angry tornado of events in my life. Moving to my own place, getting a job, spending all my savings to get me prepared for life on my own, etc, etc, etc. But today, I took time and reflected on my life over the past few months, playing the Game with different women, and the outcomes from all of them. I wouldn't call myself a master at pick up, but I am a quick learner, and I've been able to apply the practices and get outstanding results. A down side to this is that I get bored with things very quickly if they don't continue being a challenge. That being said, I can go sarge and easily get numbers, but I don't. I can easily kiss and fuck close, but I don't. I could go be the center of attention at clubs or parties, but I don't. I don't use canned material, but use the concepts behind them. I've used different techniques successfully. But the sarging all remains the same. At this very moment, I have 4 girls that I could call up and ask to be in an LTR with them and they would more than happily accept. But I don't want to be with any of them. I look back when I met them, and how I had them obsessed with me in such a short time, and it wasn't a challenge. They all turn into just another face among the crowd. I used pickup on girls I used to have one-itis for, and they all turned into something I didn't want to be with.  But here I am, still alone, unchallenged, and more miserable than before. The Game has taught me principles that lets me do whatever I please, but bringing with it the destruction of future curiosity and thrill of the chase. It's not a chase anymore to me, it's a complete bulldoze, and quite frankly, it isn't fun. So, with that, I ask you, have I completely destroyed my future, now knowing that all girls are going to play along the same biological and social strings that every other one will? Have I developed a superiority complex, and no one lives up to my standards? Is it just my bad luck that I haven't found that one intriguing girl that's different from the rest? The Game has probably been the reason I don't want to ever get married. What's the point? They're all the same. You have one, you have all of them. Maybe I'm just being emotional, and in 10 hours, I'll look back at this post and kick myself in the face for posting. I'm not going to proof read this, so if it's jumbled, oh well. If a mod wants to close it, go ahead. I'm just about to explode. -Shane

author: TheRogue
text_post: I think a lot of what you're dealing with may have to do with your age. You're young, and if I'm right, so are the girls you are sarging.  Women in their late teens/early twenties generally have very little life experience. Their identities are still forming, and many have not even gotten out on their own to break their initial social conditioning and develop their individual personality. If they're inexperienced, they won't be able to read through your game and will just fall into it like easy prey. Without unique developed principles or personality, they may appear "boring" or "the same."  Give it a few years, and I bet the game will get more interesting (and challenging). Also, try different venues for sarging. Nightclubs are not the best places for a good challenge. Sarge girls of different backgrounds, and try to find some with a different life experience than your own. It's much more fun when you can learn something from a girl, aside from just getting her into bed. Cheers, Rogue

text_post: Essentially all the advice the other posters seem to have given you revolves around trying the game in new ways or taking it to higher levels but fails to address the real reason to this come down, and it is something i have experienced in exactly the same way. The fact that you can get any girl you like- that they will fall for tricks that you know you can use on anybody- reduces their value in your eyes. Ironic though it is that by their good responses to your approaches they lower their value in your eyes, it is the case. Do more day game and spot people who look likie they have real value. -realise that, of all the guys you knew at school, you only made a handful of really good friends. if you want to meet girls you can have relationships with you have to go through the same number of non-friends. not every good looking girl is a potential mate, especially not those at clubs. meeting the right people is a struggle. all the game helps you with is to put out a net that you can select the best from. it does not generate relationships from nothing. -frequently, i would find that i could generate the feeling of a relationship with another person until the f-close or thereabouts. after that i would realise that I had artificially created rapport and that we in fact had very little in common. it is hard to see through the fun you are having with your own skills and perceive the possibility (or lack thereof) for a relationship.
